decisions.reason: This is essentially a proven trommel platform relaunched as a more flexible modular version, and the website explicitly indicates the predecessor already had strong customer acceptance.
A dedicated product page for the mobile high-speed flail shredders suggests clear strategic importance and good fit with the firm's mobile recycling machinery portfolio.

Even with only limited website visibility, a mobile high-speed grinder matches the firm's core customer needs and should be given more time because machinery products in this market typically have long sales cycles.

The stationary electric fine shredder supports the firm's move toward efficient plant-based solutions with lower operating costs, which aligns well with customer demand and the firm's stated direction.

A mobile high-speed grinder tailored to green waste serves an important customer segment and strengthens the firm's application-specific offering, so it is worth retaining despite early-stage visibility.
The stationary single-shaft pre-shredders received their own product presentation and fit the firm's strategy of broader stationary solutions for tougher material streams.
